_about: Formic acid (1) + gamma-Valerolactone (2): isobaric T-x-y at 51.0 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of formic acid, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of formic acid, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).
